# PIXZ.DEV Universal Agent Skills Ecosystem

> Portable, dependency-aware skills for Claude / OpenClaw / OpenCode / Hermes. Root registry is AGENTS.md; machine registry is registry.json.

## Entry Points
- Registry (agent): https://github.com/pixzdev/skills/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- Registry (machine): https://github.com/pixzdev/skills/blob/main/registry.json
- Overview: https://github.com/pixzdev/skills/blob/main/README.md
- Schemas: https://github.com/pixzdev/skills/blob/main/schemas/skill.schema.json

## Install
- Stable: `git clone --branch v1.0.0 https://github.com/pixzdev/skills.git`
- Resolve: `python scripts/resolve.py --install pixz.core.orchestrator --runtime claude --channel stable`
- Validate: `python scripts/validate.py && python scripts/check-cycles.py`

## Skills (28)
- Core (13): orchestrator, planning, context-engineering, environment-awareness, capability-discovery, workflow-continuity, delegation-handoff, epistemic-reasoning, epistemic-challenger, verification, change-safety, replanning, quality-gate
- Quality: anti-ai-slop
- Engineering: api-design, system-design
- Security: review, threat-modeling
- Design: uiux, design-system
- Frontend: react, accessibility
- Motion: gsap, remotion
- Devops: docker, kubernetes
- AI: rag, agent-design

## Discovery
Scan AGENTS.md trigger table → resolve dependencies → follow that skill's SKILL.md methodology → emit structured output (findings/assumptions/unknowns/evidence/decisions/verification) → quality-gate before ship.

## Versioning
SemVer per skill + ecosystem VERSION. Channels: latest / stable / pinned. IDs stable: pixz.<domain>.<name>.
